variant_rules.description: A name whose native form is non-Latin admits several Latin renderings; treat them as the same token, not as a spelling error.
Nobiliary and patronymic particles (van der, de la, al-, O', Mc) vary in spacing and capitalization between registries.
Registries publish either 'First Last' or 'LAST, First'; token order carries no identity information.
A middle initial and a full middle name are the same element rendered at different precision.
Fold combining marks before comparison. Deleting them instead splits the token: 'Müller' becomes 'm ller'.
